text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka's training is proceeding 
well, though today something 
else seems 
to be on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew. A 0.1-second improvement. If only everything could go as smoothly as my running... Sigh...
choice_data_list: Was there an issue with training...?
Was there an issue with training...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, no. It's not training that's the issue.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There's actually a fan event this weekend 
that I'm a bit worried 
about...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever focused on running, so I'm 
not really used to anything 
else.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't think of a response the last time 
a fan tried to speak with 
me. It was like the 
room was spinning, but it turns out...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was the one spinning. There was even a 
magazine article about how I 
just started 
veering left, walking in a little circle 
whenever somebody 
talked to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel anxious about fan 
events now... What if I do 
something silly 
again?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose I do kind of let that 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to resign myself to doing 
these things half-heartedly... 
But at the 
same time, I don't feel like I can do it well.
choice_data_list: Want to practice with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean practice... with you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to help prepare her for 
social events, I take on the 
role of an 
enthusiastic Suzuka fan.
choice_data_list: That run made me admire you even more!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... This might be harder than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... To say my race was amazing... 
That's quite a compliment.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And "best ever"? You must have been 
watching my races for quite 
some time... 
Right...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't try to make me feel better. It's just 
like I thought... it's far too 
late to try to 
improve my social skills...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could ever be as talkative as 
Fukukitaru is about 
fortune telling, or 
adapt to any kind of conversation like 
Taiki can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully I can manage to force a smile 
and say something at least 
somewhat 
interesting.
choice_data_list: How about I prepare a reward, then?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A treat?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The weekend comes fast, and we find 
ourselves at the fan event.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I feel almost as tense as before a 
race, but in a completely 
different way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely still a little worried about 
messing up... But yeah, I'll do 
my best.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Into the crowd I go. I'll be 
looking forward to that treat, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, I'm always rooting for you! You've 
been getting better with 
every race lately!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you! I'll make sure from now on 
to um... Uh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm privileged to have you appreciate 
all the little ways I've 
improved.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And um... Umm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch her give it her all amongst the 
throngs of fans for a while 
before setting 
out to procure the treat she chose.

text_block_list.name: Sweets Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
The end of the queue for the Royal Honey 
Carrot Tart is here! The 
wait time is 140 
minutes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I line up at a popular cake shop in the 
nearby shopping mall. It 
probably won't 
actually take 140 minutes...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Four hours... Did you really have to wait 
here that long?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I guess the tarts have to cool down 
after they're done baking 
too...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm really sorry. I couldn't think of a 
treat I wanted myself, so I 
just asked for 
the one everyone at the academy was 
talking about...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But you know, it really did motivate me to 
do my best at the fan 
event.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I mean... It's not like I was able to respond 
to everyone thoughtfully. 
But you know...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I did! Much more so than usual, at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Before now I would always be overcome 
with worry about saying or 
doing 
something embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that there was a treat waiting for 
me at the end allowed me 
to simply do my 
best and work toward it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It became like a sort of finish line for me. 
So I approached it as such.
choice_data_list: Sweets taste best after hard work!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can't wait to try it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka wears a satisfied expression 
on her face after tackling 
the day's 
unfamiliar challenge.
